messages:
tess: Quick sync 16h before mini webinar. Need a tight social cascade: X teaser, LinkedIn long-thread, 30s demo clip. Who owns what for captions + creative?
leo: I can draft copy for X + LinkedIn thread. Need final assets: 30s clip mp4, thumbnail (16:9), speaker headshots, full transcript.
maya: I'll pull clip + transcript from events ops. @jonas will you produce thumbnail + a 15s GIF? Aim for delivery by 11am PT.
jonas: Yep. Will make 3 thumbnail sizes (16:9, 1:1, 4:5) and a looped 15s GIF. Deliver PNGs + MP4. Any brand color guidance?
tess: Use launch palette v3 (shared in drive). Cadence: X teaser 09:00 PT, LinkedIn thread 12:00 PT, clip follow-up 24h later. Good?
leo: :thumbsup: Works. Messaging question: lead with benchmark stat (latency/cost) or customer quote?
maya: Benchmarks land harder but legal may flag numbers. Propose hybrid: anonymized stat + short customer line. Eg: "2x reduction in inference cost" placeholder until legal signs off.
leo: Draft thread plan (will drop copy by 8:30):
```
Tweet 1: Hook - "Shipping LLM features without exploding costs? Heres how we did it."
Tweet 2: Pain - short token-cost example
Tweet 3: Result - "2x reduction in per-token cost in production" (anonymized)
Tweet 4: How - bullets: batching, quantization, KV cache
Tweet 5: CTA - webinar signup -> rwd.in/miniweb
```
jonas: For LinkedIn thread I'll create a support image with the benchmark callout and a speaker pull-quote. Will follow launch palette.
tess: Routing: inbound signups should tag SDR queue with "mini-web-2026". @ops confirm CRM mapping?
maya: Ops already set the tag. Confirm query params: source=social_x for X, source=social_li for LinkedIn. SDRs get email + Slack ping.
leo: Engagement plan post publish: 1) reply to top 5 comments within 1h, 2) promote one strong comment into a quote post. Who's on comms duty?
jonas: I'll handle initial creative questions and handoff to community team at +1h.
schedule-bot: Draft posts created and queued: X teaser (09:00 PT), LinkedIn thread (12:00 PT). Will publish automatically if approvals present by 08:45 PT.
tess: Approval flow: leo -> maya -> legal (only if benchmarks present). If legal not back by 08:45, swap benchmark for soft stat + customer quote without numbers.
leo: I'll upload the copy here for fast review and tag @maya @jonas.
maya: Confirming assets will be uploaded by 10:30 to /shared/marketing/assets/mini-web-2026.
tess: Post-launch metrics to track: CTR, signups, CPL, and engagement rate. Quick 15m postmortem tomorrow at 10am PT to iterate messaging based on the hooks that worked.
leo: Also running A/B on the first hook: technical-first vs customer-first. Will share lift numbers in the postmortem.
maya: Added a compare row on the benchmark dashboard for this thread vs last month's webinar (engagement, CPL).
jonas: Uploading final images now. Will ping when filenames are live.
schedule-bot: Once final approval flag = YES, posts will go live at scheduled times.
